data.summary_suggestion: Submit authenticated music actions to Last.fm
data.description_suggestion: Executes an authenticated Last.fm write method to submit music data or user actions. Requires a valid session key obtained via authentication and the 'method' query parameter specifying the operation (e.g., track.scrobble, track.love, track.updateNowPlaying). Common use cases include scrobbling tracks, marking tracks as loved, and updating now playing status.
